summary.headline: Khataian Sixty-Year Cycles
summary.text: Explanation of the Khataians’ sixty-year calendrical cycles: Shakmun, Chakmun/Chunkun, and Khawun, classified as the greatest, middle, and smallest cycles. It gives the 813 Yazdgerdi epoch and the subtraction, division by sixty, and division by three used to identify the cycle and elapsed years, with 966 Yazdgerdi as the example date.
